title: SMOK Nord 6 Replacement Pod - 0.4ohm 2pk
description: Maintain peak performance in your Smok Nord 6 device with this two-pack of official Side-Fill replacement pods. Designed with ultimate convenience in mind, these 2ml capacity pods feature a solid, non-removable coil design. This completely eliminates the need for messy coil changes; when the coil reaches the end of its lifespan, simply discard the entire pod and replace it with a fresh one. These specific pods are equipped with Smok's advanced Dual Core Dual Meshed 0.4ohm coil. This twin-engine power system utilises two high-precision meshed cores to deliver instant ramp-up times and ultra-even heating. The result is bold flavour chasing and massive cloud production with every inhale. Refilling the pod is quick and straightforward thanks to the practical side-fill design. Simply pull the pod out of the device, pull out the silicone rubber plug to access the filling port, insert your e-liquid, and press the plug firmly back into place. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
